review: 702.133a-1: variant one_island only tested ordinary mana payment, not what jump-start decides; dropped it.

scenarios.title: Jump-start allows casting from the graveyard only with a card to discard
decisions: A considers casting Radical Idea from the graveyard, discarding Forest as the additional cost and tapping two Islands.

variants.label: card_to_discard
variants.expected: Casting Radical Idea from A's graveyard is legal.

variants.label: empty_hand
variants.expected: Casting Radical Idea from A's graveyard is not legal: there is no card to discard.

scenarios.title: A spell cast with jump-start is exiled instead of going anywhere else when it leaves the stack
decisions: A casts Radical Idea from the graveyard, discarding Forest and tapping two Islands.
B passes without responding; Radical Idea resolves.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: Radical Idea resolves and A draws a card (hand: 1 Plains). Radical Idea is in A's exile zone, not the graveyard. Forest is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: In response, B casts Counterspell targeting Radical Idea, tapping two Islands.
variants.expected: Counterspell resolves and Radical Idea is countered: A draws nothing, and Radical Idea is in A's exile zone, not the graveyard. Forest is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: cast_from_hand
variants.delta: Radical Idea starts in A's hand instead of the graveyard and is cast from there with no discard.
variants.expected: Radical Idea resolves and A draws a card. Radical Idea is in A's graveyard, not in exile. Forest stays in A's hand.
